hooks.name: Rule base guard
hooks.description: When the agent edits the Prolog rule base or prover, restate the rules that keep every answer provable and cited, and ask for the matching tests before it continues.

action.prompt: You just edited the Prolog rule base or prover. Before continuing: give every new rule id plain-English text in src/logic/rules.ts (with an answer sentence if its head is verdict/2); make sure no topic can prove both yes and no; keep lease facts closed-world (absent/1 only when no clause states the fact); and add a row to the matrix in tests/unit/rulebase.test.ts for each new verdict rule. Then run `npm test`.
